_comment: Atlas Vector Search index using AutoEmbed (ADR-032 pattern). Atlas reads the leaf string at `embed_source.text` and produces 1024-d vectors via the project-level Voyage credential — application code does NOT call Voyage. PREREQUISITE: in Atlas, go to Project Settings > AI Provider Integrations and connect Voyage with the API key from .env (VOYAGE_API_KEY). Apply via the seed script, the Atlas UI (Atlas Vector Search > Create > JSON), or `atlas search indexes create --collection support_conversations --file support_autoembed_idx.json --type vectorSearch --clusterName <cluster>`.
name: support_autoembed_idx
